task_prompt: The confirmation dialog for deleting an account (web/confirm-dialog.html and web/dialog-controller.js) restores focus incorrectly after a failed deletion, and its loading, error and retry states are unreliable. Repair the keyboard and assistive-technology flow while preserving the operation state, following the contract in README.md.
runtime_note: The controller is exercised under Node.js with a small fake DOM owned by the checker; the checker exits 2 (NOT_ASSESSED) when node is absent. Real-browser matrix runs are not part of this checker.
